tools.name: agent
tools.description: Delegate one self-contained piece of work to a sub-agent, or send another turn into one that already reported. A sub-agent runs in a session of its own — its own context, its own tool face — and ONLY its final report comes back to you, as a message a little later; nothing else from its session enters this conversation and it cannot see yours. Give `name` to START one: say the whole task, because it sees nothing of this conversation and cannot ask you anything. Give `session` INSTEAD to follow up on a report you already have — that session still holds everything it found, so a correction or a request for specifics costs one turn where starting over pays for the search again. Prefer it. Use delegation for work that is separable and worth a fresh context (a broad search, a focused review); not for something you could finish in a step or two yourself, and never for the same thing twice. Calling an unknown name lists the ones that exist. After it returns, end your turn: the work has not happened yet.

name.description: Which agent definition to delegate to. Give this OR session, not both.

session.description: An agent session that already reported, to send another turn into. Give this OR name, not both.

task.description: The whole task (or the whole follow-up) in its own words: what to do, what to look at, what counts as finished.

model.description: Which model runs this delegation: `<profile>` or `<profile>/<model-id>`. Only with name — a follow-up runs on what its session already froze. Omit unless you have a reason: without it the definition decides, and failing that the sub-agent runs on the same model you do. Give one when this piece of work is worth a different one than the conversation it came from. `nulya config show` lists what can run.

tools.name: render
tools.description: Render an agent definition's body to a file a session can wear. For drivers: returns that file's path, for `session new --prompt`, plus the session arguments the definition asks for. Nothing is installed and nothing is versioned — the bytes are frozen into the session header when the session is created.

tools.name: list
tools.description: Every agent definition this workspace, this machine and this package hold, in search order, with the ones an earlier layer shadows marked. For drivers: a picker's data. Never needed by a model — an unknown name already comes back with the names that exist.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Drive one delegated session to the end of its turn and print its report. For drivers: this is the command the background task started by `agent` runs; the report reaches the parent as that task's result.

agent.description: Which definition it is running, for the report's framing.

readonly.description: Hold it to tools that declare themselves read-only, refusing everything else at the kernel's gate.

max_steps.description: Step budget for the run; omitted means the kernel's own.

depth.description: How deep this delegation sits; the step it drives is told, so an indirect cycle of personas cannot recurse for ever.
